scripts.//prepare:env: `.` searches PATH when its operand has no slash, so a bare filename must be made explicitly relative for dash, which is /bin/sh on the CI runners. `base-mainnet` is remapped to `base` after sourcing so the Graph manifest gets the network name Goldsky expects.
scripts.prepare:env: ENV_FILE="${ENV_FILE:?ENV_FILE must point at an env file, e.g. ../config/dev.env}"; case "$ENV_FILE" in */*) ;; *) ENV_FILE="./$ENV_FILE" ;; esac; set -a && . "$ENV_FILE" && case "$NETWORK" in base-mainnet) NETWORK=base ;; esac && set +a && envsubst < subgraph.template.yaml > subgraph.yaml
scripts.setup-local: pnpm prepare-local && pnpm codegen && pnpm build && pnpm create-local && pnpm deploy-local
